picks.editorial_note: NSF's $1.5B X-Labs initiative adding a dedicated AI for Physical Systems funding track signals a major national-scale bet on AI research, likely to shape funding priorities across dozens of institutions.
picks.title: NSF announces 3 additional topics as part of the NSF X-Labs initiative to pursue generational breakthrough science and technology efforts

picks.editorial_note: An international team's protein language model unifying sequence and 3D structure data represents a genuine methodological advance for mapping evolutionary relationships, with broad downstream implications for structural biology.
picks.title: Uniting sequence and structure to map the protein universe | Science Tokyo

picks.editorial_note: UCLA's 'physical AI' approach, where nanowire/nanoparticle networks act as the neural network hardware itself, points toward a fundamentally different, energy-efficient computing paradigm rather than an incremental improvement.
picks.title: Toward physical AI: When the hardware becomes the neural network

picks.editorial_note: A $15M gift from the OpenAI Foundation to build open pharmacokinetic data infrastructure is a notable industry-to-academia funding commitment aimed at improving AI drug-behavior prediction across the field.
picks.title: A Gift to Help Scientists Predict How Drugs Behave in the Body

picks.editorial_note: SRI's $26.5M ARPA-H award to build an AI 'co-pilot' for rural medical care tackles a real healthcare access gap with near-term deployment potential, backed by major federal funding.
picks.title: Reuters covers SRI's work in the ARPA-H-funded PARADIGM program - SRI

picks.editorial_note: NSF's ELEGANT program targets translating semiconductor research into U.S. manufacturing for next-gen AI and high-performance computing hardware, directly addressing domestic chip supply concerns.
picks.title: NSF invests in translating low-dimensional semiconductor technologies to establish U.S. leadership in microelectronics

picks.editorial_note: Integrating the open-source Apertus model into Proton's privacy-focused Lumo assistant exposes academic AI research to tens of millions of users, a rare case of university-built models reaching mass consumer scale.
picks.title: Apertus partners with Proton's Lumo AI assistant

picks.editorial_note: Rutgers and RWJBarnabas Health's AWS-powered Innovation Hub is a substantial academic-clinical-industry partnership aimed at applying AI directly to medical education and care delivery.
picks.title: Rutgers and RWJBarnabas Health to Launch Innovation Hub, Powered by Amazon Web Services

picks.editorial_note: DARPA's prize-based push for autonomous trauma surgical robotics could meaningfully change battlefield and emergency medicine, with a competitive structure designed to accelerate real-world deployment.
picks.title: $3.5M to advance autonomous trauma robotics

picks.editorial_note: A global AI summit hosted by King Charles, with a UCLA AI officer publicly addressing AI safety and Anthropic's disclosures, reflects growing high-level political attention to AI governance.
picks.title: King Charles hosts AI summit — and more UCLA media
